procedural_matters: The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
The protest was withdrawn during an arbitration meeting, the panel proceeded in hearing the request for redress,
ITA 3270 was represented by Tito Scontrino (crew).
facts: The incident happened 30 seconds before the starting signal of race Q8 of the Purple fleet. The starting signal was made at 12:55.
The protest time limit for the Purple fleet on the 6th of June was 14:49.
ITA 3270 submitted a request for redress at 15:30.
After coming back ashore, ITA 3270 had to wait for his coach, who was on another course area.
ITA 3270 did not have access to his phone during that time.
ITA 3270 did not remember the credentials to enter the online system.
ITA 3270 did not make any attempt to come to the race office, where a terminal is available for competitors to use, to deliver his request.
conclusions: ITA 3270 failed to deliver the request for redress within two hours after the incident, as required by RRS 61.2(b)(1).
There was no good reason for the panel of the international jury to extend the time. Therefore the request for redress is invalid under RRS 61.3.
decision: The request for redress is invalid. The hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
